title: Putting the Brauer back in Brauer-Picard
summary: We establish a 6-term left exact sequence, involving Galois cohomology of the base field $\mathbb K$, and the Brauer-Picard groupoid of a fusion category. This generalizes a result of Etingof, Nikshych, and Ostrik to the setting where $\mathbb K$ is not algebraically closed. Following their example, we use this exact sequence to compute examples of graded extensions of fusion categories over $\mathbb R$.
